content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-18: The sunny shelf of bark is hot by midmorning, and the shade under the fern line smells cooler and damp. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.

content.branch_b_path: YY moved Mira reading to the shaded root without calling it surrender, then found the same fern-line seeds.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
